decision.explanation: The question asks who the CEO of Apple was in 2021. Document d2 explicitly states that Tim Cook became CEO after Steve Jobs resigned in 2011 and remained in the role through the present. Document d3 also directly refers to Tim Cook as Apple CEO in 2021. Steve Jobs is mentioned in d1, but this document refers to an event in 2021 where he attended as a non-CEO participant. There is no evidence in any source that Steve Jobs was CEO in 2021. Therefore, 'Tim Cook' is the only valid answer.
